none.comment: Initial release of `@excom/nucleus-ssr`: build-time prerendering of Nucleus Stack pages (`prerender()`, `createRenderer()`, the `nucleus-ssr` command and `runPrerender()`) into static HTML with a hydration island the browser picks up without fetching or rendering again, with a worker pool, a per-page cache, shell routes, a link check, and hydration and cold-render checks in `@excom/nucleus-ssr/testing`
